errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the backend. Is it running?
errors.backend_down: The backend is not responding. Start it with `make dev` and reload this page.

confidence.high_help: Based on real pages you uploaded.
confidence.medium_help: Based on the store page only. Check the fields.
confidence.low_help: Very little was readable. Please review every field.

source.title: Which book do you like?
source.help: Paste a store link. Optionally add a few pages or paste the description.

style.title: The detected style
style.help: This is the formula we will reuse. Edit anything that looks wrong.

theme.title: Pick an original theme
theme.help: Three new ideas built from the formula. Pick one and rename it if you like.

format.title: Choose the page mix
format.help: Formats mix page types. Edit the shares or ask for a new hybrid.

characters.title: Create and approve characters
characters.help: Pick, refine, test and approve each character, then approve a sample page.
characters.blocked: Approve all characters and the sample page.

specs.title: Book specs and page plan
specs.help: Set size, page count and book language, then plan the pages.

generate.title: Generate all pages
generate.help: Pages are drawn in batches with automatic quality checks and redo.
generate.blocked: Wait until all pages are generated.

review.title: Review the pages
review.help: Tap a page to reject it. Redo only the rejected ones.

export.title: Export the book
export.help: Build the interior and cover PDFs, and optionally upload to Google Drive.

books.title: My books
books.empty_body: Start from a book you like: paste its store link and we will build an original one.

source.url_hint: Amazon, Etsy or any shop page of the book you like.
source.files_hint: Up to 15 pages. They are used for analysis only and deleted afterwards.
source.theme_label: Describe the book or theme you want
source.text_placeholder: Paste the store description here if the page cannot be read…
source.originality_note: Only the style formula is reused – never names, characters or text from the original.

fetch.thin: The store page had very little readable content.
fetch.failed: The store page could not be loaded.
fetch.fallback: Paste the description text or upload a few pages, then analyze again.

style.none: No style yet. Fill in the fields or go back and analyze a source.
style.page_mix: Page mix of the liked book

format.hybrid_placeholder: e.g. half coloring, half mazes and tracing
format.preview_note: Title, belongs-to and end pages are added automatically. Text and puzzles are drawn by code.

characters.empty_help: Create characters from the theme, or reuse one from your library.
characters.style_anchor_help: Line rules + reference attached to every page.
characters.override_confirm: The test did not pass. Approve this character anyway?
characters.manual_verdict_help: Compare each test scene with the character sheet and mark it. Approval needs every scene marked as right (or an override).

specs.belongs_to: Include a “this book belongs to” page
specs.book_language_help: Language of the text printed in the book (independent of the app language).
specs.replan_warning: Planning again replaces the current page list.

generate.background_note: You can close the browser – generation keeps running and resumes after a restart.
generate.waiting_chatgpt: Waiting for your images from ChatGPT – see the ChatGPT tasks above. Generation continues by itself after each batch.

review.failed_banner: {{count}} page(s) failed the automatic checks. They are shown first.
review.note_placeholder: Optional note for the redo (e.g. simpler background)
review.tap_help: Tap a page to reject or un-reject it.

export.subtitle: Subtitle
export.drive_connect_hint: Connect Google Drive in Settings to upload.
export.drive_setup_hint: Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to .env, then connect in Settings.
export.folder_hint: If the folder exists, “Title (2)” is used.

prompts.title: Prompts for Claude / ChatGPT
prompts.help: Use these to plan or draw the book manually in a chat. Paste the chat’s answer back below.
prompts.import_placeholder: Paste the JSON or numbered list from the chat…
prompts.apply_confirm: Replace the current page plan with the imported one?

settings.title: Settings
settings.cost_ceiling_help: Generation pauses when reached. 0 = no ceiling.
settings.provider_help: Choose the winner of the comparison test. Keys live in .env.
settings.drive_not_configured: Add GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET to .env and restart the backend.
settings.manual_help: Without paid API keys, every AI step becomes a ChatGPT task: copy the prompt, run it in ChatGPT, paste the answer or upload the image. Everything else (puzzles, cleanup, quality checks, PDFs, Drive) stays automatic.
settings.manual_auto: Auto (on when there is no API key and no image provider)
settings.manual_off: Off – use the API / mock providers

compare.title: Compare image models
compare.help: Runs the same 10 page prompts through each provider. Score the results yourself – no winner is picked automatically.
compare.no_winner: Pick the provider in Settings after scoring.

manual.panel_help: Copy the prompt, run it in ChatGPT, then paste the answer or drop the image here. The book continues by itself after the last answer.
manual.copy_all_help: ChatGPT makes one image per reply: write “next” after each image.
manual.text_steps: 1. Copy the prompt · 2. Paste it in ChatGPT · 3. Paste ChatGPT's whole reply below
manual.image_steps: 1. Copy a prompt (or all of them) · 2. Let ChatGPT draw · 3. Drop, paste or upload each image
manual.invalid: This answer can't be used yet:
manual.fix_help: Paste it into the same ChatGPT chat, then paste the new reply here.
manual.attach_refs: Attach these pictures to your ChatGPT message:
manual.drop_here: Drop, paste (Ctrl+V) or click to upload the image
manual.bulk_help: Files named like page_12.png go to page 12; other files fill the open slots in order.
manual.setup_title: Set up ChatGPT for this book
manual.setup_help: Use one ChatGPT Project per book: its instructions and reference images keep the style and the characters consistent in every chat.
manual.setup_step1: In ChatGPT create a new Project named:
manual.setup_step2: Paste these instructions into the project instructions:
manual.setup_step3: Upload these reference images to the project files:
manual.setup_step4: Run every ChatGPT task in a chat inside this project. Update the instructions after you approve characters.
manual.no_refs: Reference images appear here after you pick characters.
